description: Compile submitted records to a downstream eval format and write the artifact under exports/. Choose jsonl (lossless, the lingua franca), csv (a flattened, lossy spreadsheet summary), inspect (UK AISI Inspect AI), or lm-eval (EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness). Optionally filter by domain, task_type, or tag. Only submitted records are exported — drafts are skipped. Returns the file path, record count, byte size, and a short preview rather than dumping the full artifact inline.

domain.description: Export only records whose metadata.domain equals this value.

format.description: The downstream format to compile to.

tag.description: Export only records carrying this tag.

task_type.description: Export only records of this task type.

name: evals_export_records

bytes.description: Byte size of the written artifact.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no submitted records matched the filter.

path.description: The on-disk path of the written export artifact.

preview.description: The first ~20 lines/rows of the artifact.

record_count.description: Number of submitted records included in the export.

title: evals-mcp-server: export records
